newsitem.title: UK: UK govt calls Blair in to discuss millennium plan.
newsitem.headline: UK govt calls Blair in to discuss millennium plan.

text.p: Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine will on Thursday meet Labour Party leader Tony Blair to discuss the future of the plan for a huge Millennium Exhibition Dome, government sources said.

Because he could be Prime Minister within months it will be impossible to find the necessary private sector finance for the Greenwich, East London scheme, unless Blair agrees to the project, according to recent newspaper reports.

The government said in October that the Dome was expected to cost 500 million stg, and that some 200 million of that would be expected to come from National Lottery profits. But costs are thought to have increased since then.
The sources declined to say what precisely will be discussed at the 1545 GMT meeting, but said it had been convened by Heseltine.
